objective: Replace bare three-handle counts and independently supplied handle-chain data by a fail-closed boundary-standardization route.
forbidden_shortcuts: unindexed proposition saying a diagram represents a manifold
public theorem parameter containing hashes or an evaluator compiler

obligations.statement: A boundary certificate is a typed finite movie from the actual boundary surgery diagram to the g-component zero-framed unlink.
Primitive movie steps are exactly framed isotopy, handle slide, and plus-or-minus-one stabilization or destabilization.
Surgery semantics turns a movie into an orientation-preserving boundary diffeomorphism.
The certificate derives the number of three-handles and the standard cap; neither is caller-supplied.
Genus detection, Laudenbach-Poenaru extension, and gluing are separate visible topology inputs.
Closed completions from any two certificates for the same lower handlebody are diffeomorphic.
The standard sphere system is transported backward through every movie step and determines d3.
The existing modular evaluator is connected only after a concrete certified-presentation bridge exists.
